grammar.label: present perfect passive
grammar.meaning: a completed action where the doer is unknown or unimportant

explanation.en: Combine the present perfect with the passive when something has been done and the result matters now.
explanation.uz: Ish bajarilgan va natijasi hozir muhim bo'lganda present perfect passive ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: The road has been closed since Monday.
grammar.negative_example: The road has closed since Monday by the police.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha majhul nisbat bir qo'shimcha bilan yasaladi; ingliz tilida ikki qism kerak.

grammar.label: modal passive
grammar.meaning: obligation or possibility applied to the receiver of an action

explanation.en: Put the modal first, then 'be', then the past participle: 'Tickets must be shown at the gate.'
explanation.uz: Avval modal fe'l, keyin 'be', keyin III shakl: 'Tickets must be shown at the gate.'

grammar.positive_example: Helmets must be worn on site.

l1_notes.uz: 'be' tushib qolishi eng keng tarqalgan xato.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Have you seen the notice? The office has been closed until Monday.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Since yesterday. No reason has been given.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: That is difficult. My application has not been approved yet.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The notice says all documents must be submitted online.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Must they be signed as well?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Yes, and a copy of the signature must be attached.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: I am afraid there is a problem with that. My licence expires this week.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Then you should call. Would it be possible to have it renewed by post?

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: I will ask. The rules have been changed three times this year.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: They have. Nothing has been explained to anyone.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: That is the true complaint, not the closing.
